data.one_liner: Customisable text widget with advanced styling, gesture interactions, and a text editing controller.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text widget and controller that let you style partial strings, handle gestures like taps and long-presses, and replace portions of text with custom widgets or inline spans using regular expressions and preset matchers.
use_when: You need to make specific substrings like URLs, emails, hashtags, or phone numbers tappable or highlighted.
You want to build custom text parsing rules with regex or custom matchers inside normal text or text fields.
avoid_when: You only need simple basic text styling without regex matching, custom gestures, or partial highlighting.
strengths: Highly customisable with preset matchers like URLs, emails, and phone numbers.
Supports interactive gestures, hover states, and mouse cursor changes per definition.
Includes a special TextEditingController for text editing support.
weaknesses: Adds overhead compared to a standard Flutter Text widget for simple use cases.

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick auto_size_text instead if your primary goal is automatically resizing text to fit within its bounds.

data.minimal_example:
CustomText(
  'URL: https://example.com/\n'
  'Email: foo@example.com',
  definitions: const [
    TextDefinition(matcher: UrlMatcher()),
    TextDefinition(matcher: EmailMatcher()),
  ],
  matchStyle: const TextStyle(color: Colors.lightBlue),
)
